title: Mobile-Bench-v2: A More Realistic and Comprehensive Benchmark for VLM-based Mobile Agents

publication.identity_basis: Same work under a new title: the retained arXiv title is Mobile-Bench-v2: A More Realistic and Comprehensive Benchmark for VLM-based Mobile Agents. The PDF title page lists the same ten authors in the same order as arXiv, and the publisher abstract describes the same slot-based instruction generation, common split with offline multi-path evaluation, pop-up and ad-app noisy split, AITZ-Noise contaminated split and ambiguous split with preset Q&A interactions.
publication.notes: Publisher proceedings edition; retained separately from the arXiv snapshot. The conference edition is retitled SMAN-Bench, for its Single-path, Multi-path, Ambiguous and Noisy task settings, and its PDF names github.com/gezelligheid0314/SMAN-Bench for code and datasets. Its abstract lists Mobile-Agent-E among the evaluated frameworks, where the retained v3 abstract names UI-Tars and OS-Atlas. The landing page metadata lists Yunxin Liu before Yuanchun Li and writes LIU, WEI in capitals; publication authors follow the PDF title page. Volume 2026 and pages 16218-16250 are explicit publisher citation metadata.
publication.title: SMAN-Bench: A Cross-System Benchmark for Mobile Agents under Single- and Multi-path, Ambiguous, and Noisy Tasks
